artworks.title: Winchelsea, Sussex
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene with an ancient tower in the left center area. Lush vegetation surrounds the tower. The horizon is faintly visible on the far right. Detailed and delicate line work suggests texture and depth in the foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on white or cream-colored paper. Three figures are seen on the left. The scene extends to the right with trees framing the composition.

artworks.title: Calm
artworks.description: The image displays a maritime scene with several sailboats clustered on calm waters, viewed from a dock level perspective. The horizon is subtly suggested by the separation of water and sky, with distant boats visible. The sky and water are depicted in soft brown and sepia tones. The brushstrokes show attention to detail, with textured sails and reflected boats. People are seen on a nearby boat, adding a human element. Additional boats can be seen in the distance against the sky. The overall scene conveys a serene and timeless quality.

artworks.title: Cornelis Mayer
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated at a desk. His face is facing forward with elongated facial features, a prominent nose, and a slight smile. He has long, wavy hair reaching past his shoulders. The man is dressed in a voluminous coat with large cuffs and a white neckband with an elaborate collar. He holds a pen in his right hand over a piece of paper on the desk, with his left hand resting on the desk. On the desk, there are various items including a balance scale, an inkwell, and a small pile of books to his left. The background features a tightly draped curtain and a shelf with glass bottles and books behind him.

artworks.title: Erasmus
artworks.artist: Wallerant Vaillant after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image depicts a person with a side profile, wearing a hat and a cloak. The person's facial features include a prominent nose and deep-set eyes. The background is plain with a textured appearance.

artworks.title: Dr. Gachet (Man with a Pipe)
artworks.description: The print shows the upper body of a man in a seated position. His head is slightly tilted to the left as he gazes forward, with one hand holding a pipe up to his mouth. The man's facial features include pronounced wrinkles on his forehead, deep-set eyes, a prominent mustache, and textured hair that is combed back. He is wearing a buttoned jacket over a white shirt. Behind him there are abstract bushes in front of a fence, and the sky is blank.

artworks.title: The Board Players
artworks.description: Two individuals are shown from the waist up sitting across from each other at a table. The person on the left is wearing a hat and spectacles, with angular facial features. They are holding a glass filled with liquid. Behind them is a third figure, possibly a woman with stylized hair. The person on the right is wearing a turban-like head covering with feathers and a robe with striped sleeves. They have subtle facial features with a prominent nose. Their hands rest on a table with a backgammon board set up. The background shows an abstracted landscape with a monkey or similar creature and faint outlines of hills or trees. The setting appears to be indoors.

artworks.title: Young Herdsman with a Bull
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a man holding a cow. The man is slightly to the left, holding a small horn and resting his arm on the back of the cow. The cow is facing right and is in the center of the composition. The background features a landscape with sparse vegetation, a few distant trees on rolling hills, and a low horizon line. The sky has minimal clouds, creating a sense of openness. The artwork is created with fine lines and intricate cross-hatching in a traditional engraving style. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of sepia, giving a classical and historical appearance.

artworks.title: Recumbent Cow
artworks.description: The image shows a cow resting on the grass, with a few more cows grazing in the distance along with some trees. The artwork features fine, linear brushstrokes suggesting an etching technique to define texture and shading, especially on the cow's fur and the grass. The scene is depicted in sepia tones and black colors, creating a rustic and tranquil countryside ambiance. The sky has soft clouds, adding to the peaceful atmosphere.

artworks.title: Standing Bull
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with several cows. Two cows are close to the viewer, with one lying down and the other standing. The background features distant trees and a sky with stylized clouds. The etched technique is used to depict fine details in the cows' textures and the grass. The color palette consists of varying shades of sepia, giving the image an antique look. Another cow can be seen grazing in the distance.

artworks.title: Two Cows and a Sheep
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a standing cow in the center, with two other cows - one sitting and one lying down - in the background. The landscape is depicted with faint lines creating a horizon. The engraving technique uses fine lines to show texture and shading on the cows and landscape. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and beige. Soft lines in the background suggest clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Three Cows
artworks.description: The image shows a cow standing in the foreground, with two more cows grazing in the background. A tree with few leaves is positioned to the right. The style is a monochromatic etching with detailed textures of the fur and tree bark. The horizon is high in the composition with a faint cloud line.

artworks.title: Bull Standing in Water
artworks.description: The image shows a cow standing in shallow water. The horizon line is low, with hills and other cows visible in the distance. The artwork features detailed linear etching to depict the cow's fur and the water ripples. The color scheme is monochromatic with varying shades of sepia.

artworks.title: Grazing Horse
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse standing in a pastoral landscape. The composition includes a large horse grazing in the foreground, with its head lowered. In the background, a smaller horse and a few sheep are present, some grazing. The landscape features slight elevations, sparse vegetation, and a few bushes or small trees. The sky is lightly sketched with a few clouds. The drawing uses fine lines and shading to show the horse's musculature and the landscape texture.

artworks.title: Grazing Calf
artworks.description: The image shows a cow grazing on a patch of grass in a pastoral landscape. The ground is detailed with etching techniques to depict grass and earth. In the distance, there are hills, a sky with clouds, and other cows. The cow in focus is detailed with fine lines, showcasing its hair and frame. The artwork is in a classic etching style, using shades of gray, brown, and black. Other elements in the scene include a felled log and a tree, creating a rural and tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Fighting Dogs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three animals in a landscape. Two of the animals are engaged in a physical encounter. The drawing shows two dogs or similar animals in a confrontational pose. One animal is lunging over the other, which is on the ground. The third animal in the background is walking across the grassy landscape. The sky has scattered clouds and a pattern of birds in flight. The drawing uses lines and shading to show texture in the fur of the animals and the landscape.

artworks.title: Recumbent Goats
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two goats lying on the ground with a small wooden structure in the background. The scene depicts a rustic landscape with two goats in the foreground. The goat on the left has curved horns and looks directly at the viewer, while a smaller goat lies beside it. In the background, a cart or wooden wagon is seen on a slight rise of earth. The sky has softly drawn clouds, creating a tranquil atmosphere. The drawing uses fine line work to detail the fur of the goats and the landscape.

artworks.title: Peasants Lunching in Open Air
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five men around a small table outdoors. Their distinct features and clothing typical of the time are visible. They are seated on makeshift stools, with two men standing and conversing. In the background, more people are gathered around a village fair or market, with a tall church steeple in the distance.

artworks.title: Air
artworks.artist: Jan van de Velde II after Willem Buytewech
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting a rural scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon line is relatively high in the composition, featuring distant figures and a settlement with a church steeple. The engraved lines provide detailed textures to elements like a thatched roof and a large tree. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on a light background emphasizing contrast. Closest to the viewer, figures are engaged in activities like hunting with falcons. Further back, a group of animals pulls a cart near more figures, and in the distance, people are working on and around a raised mound.

artworks.title: Water
artworks.artist: Jan van de Velde II after Willem Buytewech
artworks.description: There is a drawing of a group of individuals near a coastal area with boats. The scene depicts people engaged in various activities, including conversations, carrying baskets, and tending to animals. In the background, a building or tower is visible, along with boats on the water. The foreground shows fish on the ground and a fire pit. The image is rich in texture, with hatching and cross-hatching techniques used for detail. Written text is seen at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Fire
artworks.artist: Jan van de Velde II after Willem Buytewech
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene from a side view perspective, showing a group of people engaging in various activities along a dock or riverside. A wooden crane-like structure is visible, along with other architectural elements like barrels and buildings. The style uses fine lines and cross-hatching for detail and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and white. In the background, smoke rises, and a small group of people is seen in the distance.

artworks.title: Earth
artworks.artist: Jan van de Velde II after Willem Buytewech
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people engaged in various activities in a rural setting. The scene features figures carrying baskets on their heads, interacting with animals and each other, along with baskets and barrels filled with produce. In the background, there are buildings and arches, suggesting a village or farm setting. Trees, fields, and a softly rendered sky with clouds can be seen on the horizon. The artwork employs fine linework and hatching with a monochromatic palette to emphasize texture and form. The depiction captures a detailed view of rural life with a bustling community set against a harmonious backdrop of natural landscape and architecture.

artworks.title: Death Taking a Couple by Surprise
artworks.description: The image contains two individuals and a skeletal figure in an interior space. The person on the left is seated at a table, holding a goblet. They have an intricate hairstyle and ornate clothing. The second person stands next to them, holding a cup. They have short, textured hair and wear elegant attire. Behind them is a skeletal figure holding an hourglass in one hand and resting the other on the second person's shoulder. The background shows a landscape with trees and architectural elements. In the foreground, there are various items on a table, including vessels, books, and a sheathed sword.

artworks.title: Two Figures in Costume
artworks.description: The image shows two people standing. The person on the left is standing in profile with their right hand leaning against a doorway. They have short hair under a tall hat and are wearing a cloak, a collared shirt, puffed breeches, and buckled shoes. The person on the right is facing forward, wearing a broad ruffled collar, a long gown fitted at the waist, and a bonnet. They appear to be gesturing slightly with their hands at their sides. The intricate line work depicts a home interior or exterior near a wooden door with foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Two Figures in Costume
artworks.description: The image depicts a man and a woman standing close together. The woman has her hair up, with a visible hairline and delicate facial features. She is wearing a high-collared ruffled dress with long sleeves. The man has shoulder-length hair and wears a hat, with defined features and a neutral expression. He is dressed in a long coat with a cape-like garment. The woman appears to be holding her dress, while the man has one arm behind her and another at his side. In the background, there are trees, a structure in the distance, a textured wall, and a column. The sky is partially cloudy with a few birds flying.
